tools.name: exec
tools.description: Run a command on a host and return its output as soon as the process exits (default limit 45 s). Two modes: 'command' (a shell line; on Windows host 'local' it runs in cmd.exe) or 'argv' (no shell: each item reaches the program exactly as given; use it for code and text with metacharacters). Long code goes through 'input' (stdin): argv ['node','-'], ['python','-'] or ['pwsh','-NoProfile','-Command','-'] with the script in 'input'. Prefer read_file to read files, file_ops to manage them, code_outline/code_graph to locate code, and the 'job' tool for anything over ~30 s. On timeout the partial output is returned and the process tree is killed (on Windows 'local' it keeps running as a background job instead); stdin without 'input' is an immediate EOF.

argv.description: No-shell alternative: [program, arg1, ...]; no metacharacter is interpreted. Give argv OR command

command.description: Shell line (artificial sleep/timeout is blocked). Give command OR argv

cwd.description: Working directory (relative paths resolve from the host default, e.g. 'app/config')

input.description: Content sent to the process stdin

timeout_ms.description: Limit in ms (default 45000, max 50000 to stay under the client's 60 s cut); longer work goes to 'job'

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a local or remote file, whole or a slice (byte offset/limit start_line/end_line, ranges 'a-b,c-d', or pattern+context; local files). Files over 32 KB come back cut; use code_outline first. Use it instead of cat, type or head through exec.

pattern.description: Regex (case-insensitive): return matching lines with context, numbered

ranges.description: Several line ranges in one call, e.g. '10-40,90-120' (numbered)

tools.name: code_outline
tools.description: List a source file's declarations (funcs, types, classes, methods, routes) as 'L<line>: <signature>', or find where a symbol is declared across a directory (skips .git, node_modules, dist, vendor...). Use before read_file or grep to locate code. Go, C/C++, TS/JS, Python, shell, PowerShell.

host.description: 'local' (default) or a remote host; directories only on 'local'

symbol.description: Name or part of it (case-insensitive); omit for the full outline

tools.name: code_graph
tools.description: Code graph of a local repository (incremental index, built on first use, refreshed on every call): 'callers' = where a symbol is called or referenced; 'def' = where it is declared (line range, signature); 'impact' = files that use what a file or symbol defines (check before refactoring). Go via go/ast; C/C++, TS/JS, Python, shell by line scanners; matched by name, no type resolution.

repo_path.description: Repository root or any path inside it (host 'local')

target.description: File (relative to repo or absolute) for impact

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Change an existing file (local or remote) by exact text replacement: 'target' -> 'replacement', or several changes in one call with 'edits' (applied in order, all or nothing). Line endings (LF/CRLF) are matched automatically. Prefer this over write_file for any change to an existing file.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a file (local or remote). An existing non-empty file is refused unless overwrite is true; to change parts of a file use edit_file.

atomic.description: Write to a temp file and rename it into place

overwrite.description: Replace an existing non-empty file entirely

tools.name: file_ops
tools.description: File system operations without a shell: copy, move, delete, mkdir, list. Use it instead of ls, dir, rm or mkdir through exec.

tools.name: job
tools.description: Background jobs that outlive the call (dev servers, watchers, tunnels, anything over ~30 s): systemd-run on Linux hosts, a named Job Object with a log file on Windows 'local' (max 12 active, 12 h lifetime; 'stop' kills the whole tree). 'wait' blocks up to 45 s per call and returns only the log lines that are new since the previous wait.

tools.name: tool_manage
tools.description: On-demand tool modules ('sql', 'hosts', 'docker'), kept out of the schema to save tokens: 'search' tools by keyword, 'list' modules, 'enable'/'disable' a module (sends list_changed), or 'call' a module tool directly without loading it.

tools.name: handoff
tools.description: Session handoff and long-term memory built from real telemetry (no LLM): 'latest' returns the last project briefing (~300 tokens) for a cold start; 'save' records the session (files touched, failures to avoid, next steps) in Markdown; 'search' finds past decisions; 'list' lists handoffs.

pending.description: Pending items or next steps for 'save'

tools.description: Last log lines of a Docker container
tools.name: docker_logs

tools.description: List running (or all) Docker containers with status and ports
tools.name: docker_ps

tools.description: Download a file from a remote host over the binary socket.

local_path.description: Local path (default: the file name in the current directory)

remote_path.description: File path on the remote host

tools.name: get_file

tools.description: Latency and connectivity check against the configured hosts.
tools.name: ping

tools.description: Upload a local file to a remote host (chunked, atomic).

remote_path.description: Destination path on the remote host

tools.name: put_file

tools.description: Run analytic SQL: DuckDB (straight on files, or a 'session') or SQLite ('database'). Output is plain JSON.

query.description: SQL to run (DuckDB accepts 'SELECT ... FROM "path/file.jsonl"' directly)

session.description: DuckDB analytic session name (one sandbox folder per session)

tools.name: sql
